nodes.name: First National Digital Currency Bank / Circle National Trust
Aviva Investors USD Liquidity Fund tokenised share class

edges.detail: OCC CAS lists consummated/effective 2026-10-26; Ripple describes reserve management, collateral trustee and fiduciary custody scope
RLUSD issuance remains with NYDFS-regulated Standard Custody & Trust Company
Authorized plan as described by Ripple; operations upon opening not verified
BNY and Ripple say they are exploring a supply-chain finance initiative with C2FO
Participating capital providers fund accelerated supplier payments against approved invoices; actual XRPL funding volume not disclosed
OCC Corporate Decision #1370 describes the proposed bank as a wholly owned Coinbase subsidiary
OCC decision says the entirety of the current NYDFS-chartered custody business is planned to migrate over a three-year de novo period after the bank is authorized to operate
Custody clients may access affiliate staking, Prime Trading and Prime Financing; the proposed bank does not itself provide those underlying services
Coinbase states cbXRP is backed 1:1 by XRP held by Coinbase; current reserve page has conflicting indexed/direct render timestamps
cbXRP reserve disclosure lists XRP backing held by Coinbase
Coinbase says its USDC crypto-backed loans are powered by Morpho on Base
DeFiLlama displays a cbXRP/USDC Morpho Blue Base market; exact Coinbase customer attribution is not established
Haircuts and average-daily-quantity concentration limits apply; XRP-specific haircut not disclosed
XRP-PERP settles in USDC every five minutes; 50x maximum leverage and 25% default initial margin

hypotheses.claim: BNY custody support and effective trust-bank charters reduce operational barriers to institutional holding and servicing of XRP/RLUSD.
supporting: BNY says it supports XRP and RLUSD custody.
OCC CAS records show Ripple and Circle trust-bank charters effective on 2026-10-26 and 2026-07-24.
disconfirming: No client XRP balances, custody AUM, operating launch metrics or new net XRP purchases are disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: C2FO Instant Pay may route actual supplier-financing capital through XRPL with RLUSD settlement.
supporting: Ripple/C2FO say participating capital providers fund instant supplier payments and XRPL/RLUSD settle them.
C2FO has an existing platform-wide early-payment history.
disconfirming: Instant Pay waitlist is the stated availability path; no XRPL funded invoice or settlement volume is disclosed.
The USD 520B figure belongs to existing C2FO Early Pay programs, not XRPL Instant Pay.

hypotheses.claim: A launched Aviva tokenized liquidity-fund share class establishes a live institutional fund asset on XRPL.
supporting: Aviva confirms launch on XRPL and CBI approval.
Komainu, Licuido and BNY roles are identified.
disconfirming: Tokenized share-class AUM, holdings, investor count and secondary turnover are not disclosed.
This is not evidence of XRP collateral or material XRP spot demand.

hypotheses.claim: EUR CoinVertible could become trading collateral in Ripple products.
supporting: SG-FORGE confirms EURCV launched on XRPL with Ripple custody support.
disconfirming: SG-FORGE describes collateral use as an opportunity to explore; no live collateral integration or balances are disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: These custody, trust-bank and tokenized-finance relationships prove net XRP buying or a directional price catalyst.
disconfirming: RLUSD and EURCV are issued stablecoins; Aviva fund shares are tokenized fund interests; custody support is not a proprietary purchase.
No XRP net-flow, collateral balance, funded trade-finance volume or XRP purchase quantity is disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's proposed national trust bank could consolidate federal oversight of institutional custody and facilitate custody-adjacent affiliate services.
supporting: OCC Corporate Decision #1370 grants preliminary conditional approval and describes fiduciary custody, related transactions and finder access.
The decision describes a planned migration of the existing NYDFS-chartered custody business over a three-year de novo period.
disconfirming: The OCC decision explicitly says final approval and authorization to commence business require preopening conditions.
No later Consummated/Effective action or operational launch was identified in the OCC CAS record retrieved on 2026-10-31.
The proposed bank does not itself provide the underlying staking, Prime Trading or Prime Financing services.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's cbXRP reserve and Morpho market create a pathway for existing XRP holdings to be wrapped, posted as collateral and reused for USDC credit without selling native XRP.
supporting: Coinbase says USDC loans against XRP use Morpho on Base.
A cbXRP/USDC Morpho market is publicly displayed with a 62.5% maximum LTV.
disconfirming: Coinbase's current reserve page has conflicting search-indexed and direct-page snapshot dates.
The exact Morpho market is not proven to be exclusively Coinbase customer activity.
No customer-level collateral, mint/redeem, loan-originations or liquidator-sale data is disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase XRP derivatives and cross-margin acceptance create additional XRP exposure and potential collateral demand.
supporting: Coinbase documents XRP as accepted Global Exchange collateral and lists XRP-PERP.
Coinbase also offers a separate cash-settled XRP futures product.
disconfirming: Perpetual and dated futures settle in USDC/cash and do not require physical XRP delivery.
XRP-specific posted collateral, position size and hedge flows are not disclosed.

limitations: Effective OCC charter status is not proof of a bank's operational opening or live customer services.
RLUSD remains issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company; Ripple National Trust Bank is not the issuer.
BNY custody platform support does not disclose client balances or imply BNY is buying XRP.
C2FO's historical USD 520B Early Pay figure is not XRPL activity and must not be attributed to Instant Pay.
Aviva's tokenized fund share class is live, but AUM, investor count and on-chain turnover are not disclosed.
SG-FORGE collateral use and Mastercard/WebBank/Gemini settlement remain exploratory in the cited announcements.

Coinbase National Trust's conditional charter must not be compared as an effective operating charter with Ripple National Trust Bank and Circle National Trust; the OCC decision is preliminary and the CAS record retrieved on 2026-10-31 shows Approved but no Consummated/Effective action.
cbXRP reserve search snippet and direct page open displayed different snapshot dates; preserve both and do not claim a verified current reserve change.
Coinbase Borrow, Global Exchange cross-collateral and XRP-PERP are separate products with different collateral and liquidation rules.
The 62.5% Morpho market parameter is not automatically the Coinbase retail loan's initial LTV or proof of Coinbase-only borrower activity.
